archetype_description: A mix of Organic & Earthy (warmth, trust, calming) and Vibrant Play (friendly, engaging for kids). The aesthetic is 'simple like Duolingo, soft like Headspace'.

background.description: Warm beige / light yellow, representing African warmth and serving as a calming background.

primary.description: Soft brick red (force, sacrifice, energy). Used for main CTAs, 'Lingala' in logo, and prominent actions.

secondary.description: Soft green (earth, life, nature). Used for playful elements, 'Mwana' in logo, accents, and progress indicators.

surface.description: White or soft cream for large cards to pop against the beige background.

typography.rules: Use Nunito everywhere to maintain a highly friendly, rounded, and child-appropriate aesthetic. Headings should be tight and bold, while body text remains extremely readable and relatively large.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Cards must have massive internal padding to feel soft and approachable. No cramped elements.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use max-w-7xl for standard pages. Add generous vertical padding (py-16 md:py-24) to sections.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Massive padding (p-8 md:p-12), large border radius (rounded-3xl or rounded-[2rem]).
spacing_and_layout.buttons: Oversized tap targets (min-h-[60px] or py-5 px-10), pill-shaped (rounded-full).
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use 1-column on mobile. On desktop, use a bento-style or 2/3-column grid for mode selectors (Baby, Child, Parent).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full hover:bg-primary/90 transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-white rounded-full hover:bg-secondary/90 transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-md
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary rounded-full hover:bg-primary/5 transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.06)] border border-black/5 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300

baby_mode_player.description: Audio-first interface. A massive, central play/pause button (e.g., 150x150px) taking up most of the screen. Zero distractions, screen can be locked.

child_mode_quiz.description: Large image cards with audio triggers. Dopamine-driven but gentle feedback (soft chimes, subtle bouncy animations, not overwhelming flashes).

parent_dashboard.description: Clean, structured bento grid showing child progress, selected themes, and toggle for Christian mode. Slightly smaller spacing than child views but still cohesive.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Soft lift (-translate-y-1) and slight shadow increase for cards.
motion_and_interaction.active: Gentle scale down (active:scale-95) for all buttons to provide tactile 'squish' feedback.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Fade and slight upward slide for new content (staggered if a list).
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Soft morphing shapes or color shifts for rewarding actions. Avoid aggressive vibrations or strobe effects.

illustrations.description: Soft minimalist illustration of an African mother holding her baby.
African kids playing with letter blocks in a soft Duolingo style.
Cute African baby sleeping peacefully with music notes.
Minimalist white dove with an open book and sun rays.

photography.description: Real photo of a happy African family.
Real photo of African children in a learning environment.
Real photo of a cute African baby.

icons.style: Use rounded, soft, bold icons. Size should be larger than standard (e.g., w-8 h-8 or w-10 h-10) to appeal to kids.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='baby-mode-play-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure tailwind.config.js with the custom colors: primary (#C62828), secondary (#2E7D32), and background (#F5E6C8).
Use Nunito font everywhere (import via Google Fonts).
Do NOT use generic Shadcn cards for the main Marketing/Child pages; build custom HTML/Tailwind cards with generous padding (p-8/p-12) and rounded-3xl borders.
Ensure all buttons have active:scale-95 for tactile feedback.
Build the Baby mode as a distraction-free screen with a massive play button.
Use the provided image URLs (both illustrations and photography) in the UI where appropriate (e.g., Hero section, mode cards).
Avoid flag-like color blocking; use the beige background to soften the red and green accents.
